HOUSE_4: Parents / Hidden Things. Father, Home, Lands, The Grave, End of the Matter.

HOUSE_6: Illness / Bad Fortune. Sickness, Slaves, Injuries, Animals.

HOUSE_8: Death / Idle Place. Death, Inheritance, Fear, Torment.
HOUSE_9: God / Long Journeys. Religion, Philosophy, Kings, Astrology.
